notes: Effectiveness predictor, LoRA with a same-history ranking loss: starts the scalar head from the frozen-backbone baseline, lower learning rates, binomial NLL plus lambda times a pairwise ranking loss over AFTER pairs of one history whose rollout success rates differ by at least 2/9. Same K = 9 labels as v5_predictor_lora.json.

predictor.pilot_decision: 2026-10-01 user decision: LoRA separated responses within a history better than the frozen head (ordering, delta sign) but was poorly calibrated; retrain with lower learning rates and a ranking loss

training.training_notes: learning_rate is the head rate, lora_learning_rate the adapter rate. ranking.lambda weights the mean pairwise ranking loss of a batch; min_after_gap = 2/9. Batches keep the examples of a history together. Every epoch's checkpoint is kept (epochs/), with best (DEV NLL) and best_ordering.
